positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
Created a wireframe and built college’s internal website using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery and provide ongoing maintenance.
Developed and delivered engaging lectures about .NET and Database Management System to undergraduate students
Demonstrated a continued commitment to undergraduate teaching through full participation in the college community and extra activities such as meetup and seminars.

projects.title: Restaurant App
projects.description:
♣	Allows user to create/edit/delete restaurants and menu items.

projects.title: NYC Neighborhood Map
projects.description:
♣	Single-page application built with Google Maps API and hosted on Github Pages.
♣	Developed a full-page map that shows nearby listings around the location.
♣	Users can view each listing in Google street view and – retrieved by Google API.
